core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sabeeh is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Beautiful, handsome”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabeeh corresponds to the Arabic form صَبِيح (Arabic root ص ب ح (ṣ-b-ḥ); صَبِيح (Ṣabīḥ)). Its core sense is sabeeh; beautiful, handsome. Sabeeh is Arabic صَبِيح (Ṣabīḥ) 'beautiful, handsome', from the root ص ب ح (ṣ-b-ḥ). The source gloss 'Pure, Clear' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as sabih.
